name: Frustum-Occlusion Culling for Octree Traversal
aliases: Voxel LOD selection via Frustum Culling
Voxel Rasterization via Frustum Culling and Instancing
summary: Frustum-Occlusion Culling for Octree Traversal identifies visible voxels by traversing an octree and culling subtrees based on screen-space projected area, differing from ray-marching by operating in screen-space rather than using per-ray intersection tests.
